decisions.reason: Substantial investment and repeated public releases make early withdrawal unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Less visible launch and lower sunk costs mean weaker commitment, yet the firm still tends to persist.
Home-page visibility and a dated public announcement reflect strong public commitment.
As the announced flagship and central direction, dropping it remains virtually unthinkable.
A dedicated page signals visible investment that management will justify by persisting.
Its own page reflects public commitment and sunk resources favoring continuation.
